title: DNA binding site II is required for RAD51 recombinogenic activity in Arabidopsis thaliana
authors: Valentine Petiot; Charles White; Olivier Da Ines
one_liner_zh: 该文通过拟南芥RAD51位点II突变体研究其重组酶活性，属实验生物学，无AI或物理模拟方法，仅间接涉及蛋白-DNA结合功能，与本课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Homologous recombination is a major pathway for the repair of DNA double strand breaks, essential both to maintain genomic integrity and to generate genetic diversity. Mechanistically, homologous recombination involves the use of a homologous DNA molecule as a template to repair the break. In eukaryotes, the search for and invasion of the homologous DNA molecule is carried out by two recombinases, RAD51 in somatic cells and RAD51 and DMC1 in meiotic cells. During recombination, the recombinases bind overhanging single-stranded DNA ends to form a nucleoprotein filament, which is the active species in promoting DNA invasion and strand exchange. RAD51 and DMC1 carry two major DNA binding sites - essential for nucleofilament formation and DNA strand exchange, respectively. Here, we show that the function of RAD51 DNA binding Site II is conserved in the plant, Arabidopsis. Mutation of three key amino acids in Site II does not affect RAD51 nucleofilament formation but inhibits its recombinogenic activity, analogous to results from studies of the yeast and human proteins. We further confirm that recombinogenic function of RAD51 DNA binding site II is not required for meiotic DSB repair when DMC1 is present. The Arabidopsis RAD51-II3A separation of function mutant shows a dominant negative phenotype, pointing to distinct biochemical properties of eukaryotic RAD51 proteins. Summary blurb The activity promoted by RAD51 DNA binding site II is not required for nucleofilament formation, but is essential for subsequent invasion and strand exchange activity of RAD51 in Arabidopsis thaliana .
abstract_zh: 同源重组是修复DNA双链断裂的主要途径，对于维持基因组完整性和产生遗传多样性都至关重要。在机制上，同源重组涉及使用同源DNA分子作为模板来修复断裂。在真核生物中，寻找并侵入同源DNA分子的过程由两种重组酶执行：体细胞中的RAD51以及减数分裂细胞中的RAD51和DMC1。在重组过程中，重组酶结合突出的单链DNA末端形成核蛋白丝，这是促进DNA侵入和链交换的活性形式。RAD51和DMC1具有两个主要的DNA结合位点——分别对核蛋白丝形成和DNA链交换至关重要。在此，我们展示了RAD51 DNA结合位点II的功能在植物拟南芥中是保守的。位点II中三个关键氨基酸的突变不影响RAD51核蛋白丝的形成，但抑制其重组活性，这与酵母和人类蛋白质研究的结果类似。我们进一步确认，当DMC1存在时，RAD51 DNA结合位点II的重组功能并非减数分裂DSB修复所必需。拟南芥RAD51-II3A分离功能突变体表现出显性负效应表型，指向真核RAD51蛋白的独特生化特性。摘要简介 RAD51 DNA结合位点II所促进的活性并非核蛋白丝形成所需，但对拟南芥中RAD51随后的侵入和链交换活性至关重要。
